newsitem.title: FRANCE: Broker Transbourse recommends some property stocks.
newsitem.headline: Broker Transbourse recommends some property stocks.

text.p: Brokerage house Transbourse issued a list of buy recommendations on Tuesday on shares in property groups Immeubles de France, Sefimeg and Simco, citing renewed interest in the hammered sector.

Its study, titled ImmoBook, estimated returns at five to six percent in residential property, 6.5 to 7.25 percent on office property and 7.5 to eight percent on commercial centres but stressed these returns were "absolutely not guaranteed".
The report had little impact on the share prices. Sefimeg and Simco shares were up slightly at midday, but Immeubles de France shares were lower.
